game_concept: A action puzzle set in Eldritch Ruins – Moss Library, a ruined library: the tomb cartographer must handle cursed statues while practicing lists. Core idea – Matrix Map: Navigate a list of lists as rows and columns of a map.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Moss Library: a ruined library
core_gameplay_loop: In Moss Library, repeat each round: Navigate a list of lists as rows and columns of a map. Each round, a new chalk marks challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the map_cells value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 490 points of chalk marks by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 490, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 8 (extended tier): Matrix Map
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Matrix Map' (Week 7 slot 8), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Moss Library'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Eldritch Ruins
region.mood: eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how map_cells changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against cursed statues in Moss Library.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 490 within 41 seconds.
